title: The bot's host moves to its own VM; J01, J05 and J06 pass there
gate: BARKBOT_HOST_NAME="BarkBot VM" BARKBOT_LIVE_DIR=vm npm run turn:live -- --bot <the VM's Main Bot> (J01; add --resume for J06, restarting barkbot-host on the VM at the prompt) and node scripts/cancel-live.mjs --session <its conversation> --ssh barkbot@<vm> (J05). Owner-run: the owner's Barkpark login and the VM online. Records: parity/live/vm/turn.json, cancel.json, resume.json
evidence: The VM: Hetzner warm-52d0bbcf (x86_64, Ubuntu 22.04), taken out of Barkpark Cloud's warm pool (its pool row deleted with the owner's approval, 2026-11-19; labelled barkbot-host). User barkbot, one locked folder ~/BarkBot/home, barkpark-chat-host built from Barkpark origin/main 66059cd3bc under systemd (barkbot-host.service, restarts on failure), Claude Code 2.1.328 signed in by the owner, bp on PATH (Barkpark refuses a registered host's turn without task_hands: 422 chat_unsupported). Enrolled as 'BarkBot VM' beside 'BarkBot Mac'; a conversation is pinned to one computer when it is made, and the app picks the computer by name (BARKBOT_HOST_NAME). Seen live 2026-11-19, every turn checked to land on the VM's conversation and its Claude session: J01 on a fresh conversation, its first message (2026-11-20, after #287): the page made the conversation on the VM and the reply came in 7.4 s, 1 + 1 bubbles, the same after a reload; turn-live now refuses, sending nothing, when the page's conversation is not on the computer named, and also when it cannot tell: the stream hook never ran, or the page shows bubbles but opened no conversation stream (scripts/lib/host-guard.mjs, held by npm run check on a stub page); only an empty page waits for the check after the turn, which every send now has. J06 the VM's host restarted within 2 s (systemctl restart) and the bot gave the code back. J05 at the plumbing only (C1: the app has no Stop): cancel-live starts only on an idle conversation and interrupts only a turn it started (its own newest user row); an interrupt 636 characters into a long reply ended the turn as turn_completed interrupted in 984 ms, and the host program's claude child went from 1 to 0. cancel.json names barkbot 7f18826, which has no cancel-live guards: it ran at 23:00:51 +0100 on the guards before they were committed 14 s later in 6b32831, so the record cannot prove which code ran. The first message to a new conversation was never sent until #287 (the stream proxy waited for Barkpark's first body byte, 30 s on an empty conversation; task-7ec7bb04a1125c4d). Not yet: the Mac's host still runs; the cut-over (the app's default computer, then stopping the Mac) is not done.
